response.answer: I couldn't answer this: the query was blocked by a guardrail because queries over v_attempts_clean must have literal lower and upper bounds on created_at in the WHERE clause, and this one's date bounds were combined in a way the check didn't accept. No data was returned, so I can't yet say why the UPI success rate dropped between 22-31 August and 1-10 September. The query can be rewritten to satisfy the time-window rule, for example by running each period as a separate query with simple literal bounds, and then compared by issuer and acquirer.
